content: In case of a TCP socket connection the SoAd shall confirm the reception of all data either forwarded to the upper layer or fina l l y handled by SoAd (e.g. discarded data or processed PDU Header) by calling TcpIp_TcpReceived() within SoAd_RxIndication() or SoAd_MainFunction() respectively.

In case of a TCP socket connection the SoAd shall confirm the reception of all data either forwarded to the upper layer or fina l l y handled by SoAd (e.g. discarded data or processed PDU Header) by calling TcpIp_TcpReceived() within SoAd_RxIndication() or SoAd_MainFunction() respectively.

In case of a TCP socket connection the SoAd shall confirm the reception of all data either forwarded to the upper layer or finally handled by SoAd (e.g. discarded data or processed PDU Header) by calling TcpIp_TcpReceived () within SoAd_RxIndication () or SoAd_MainFunction () respectively.
